# Google Skillshop

> Google Skillshop is a comprehensive learning platform offering free training courses on Google products, digital marketing, career development, and specialized tools like Waze Map Editor and YouTube monetization.

Skillshop provides structured learning paths and certifications across multiple domains including digital skills, career readiness through the Grow with Google HBCU program, content creation, map editing, and business tools. Courses are available in multiple languages and cater to beginners through advanced users.

## Key Topics

- Waze Map Editor
- YouTube Monetization
- Digital Skills
- Career Readiness
- Google Products
- Content ID
- Grow with Google HBCU
- Certification Courses
- Map Editing
- Copyright Management
- Learning Platform
- Training Courses
- Business Tools
- Career Development
- Content Creation

## Course Catalog & Discovery

- [All Topics: Google](https://skillshop.exceedlms.com/student/catalog/browse): Browse Google's complete course catalog covering digital skills and products.
- [All Activities: Google](https://skillshop.exceedlms.com/student/catalog/list): View all training activities including Waze Map Editor and career readiness courses.

## Waze Map Editor Training

- [Waze Map Editor - Grundlagen](https://skillshop.exceedlms.com/student/path/1426417-waze-map-editor-grundlagen): Beginner Waze Map Editor course on roles, levels, and basic editing.
- [Editor Peta Waze Lanjutan - Kotak Persimpangan dan Jalur](https://skillshop.exceedlms.com/student/path/1435678-editor-peta-waze-lanjutan-kotak-persimpangan-dan-jalur): Advanced Waze Map Editor training on junction boxes, paths, and certification.
- [L'Éditeur de Carte Waze Avancé - Boîtes de jonction et Chemins](https://skillshop.exceedlms.com/student/path/1424883-l-editeur-de-carte-waze-avance-boites-de-jonction-et-chemins): Advanced Waze Map Editor certification on junction boxes and routing optimization.
- [Editor Peta Waze - Sarankan Suntingan - Moderator](https://skillshop.exceedlms.com/student/path/1725501-editor-peta-waze-sarankan-suntingan-moderator): Waze moderator training on reviewing map suggestions and editor feedback.

## Career Development & Digital Skills

- [Build Your Digital Skills - Grow with Google HBCU Career Readiness Program](https://skillshop.exceedlms.com/student/path/831446-build-your-digital-skills): Digital skills training on Google tools for workplace productivity.
- [Land a Great Job - Grow with Google HBCU Career Readiness Program](https://skillshop.exceedlms.com/student/path/831458-land-a-great-job): Career readiness course on job search, resume writing, and interview preparation.
- [Apprenez les principes de base du code](https://skillshop.exceedlms.com/student/collection/724569-basics-code): Beginner coding course covering programming languages and code fundamentals.
- [Concetti di base del marketing digitale](https://skillshop.exceedlms.com/student/collection/1830746-concetti-di-base-del-marketing-digitale): Digital marketing basics covering SEO, social media, and ecommerce strategies.

## YouTube Content Creation & Monetization

- [透過資產盈利](https://skillshop.exceedlms.com/student/path/8029): YouTube monetization training covering Content ID, analytics, and revenue optimization.
- [Quyền sở hữu nội dung](https://skillshop.exceedlms.com/student/path/8262-quy-n-s-h-u-n-i-dung): YouTube copyright and content ownership guide for creators.

## Waze for Cities Platform

- [Vamos começar](https://skillshop.exceedlms.com/student/path/1844779-vamos-comecar): Getting started guide for Waze for Cities platform and features.
- [Alerting Drivers About Construction, Incidents, and Road Hazards](https://skillshop.exceedlms.com/student/path/1871941-je-souhaite-alerter-les-conducteurs-des-travaux-de-construction-des-incidents-routiers-des-dangers-etc): Training on alerting drivers about construction, incidents, and road hazards.

## Assessments & Certifications

- [Evaluation sur la monétisation des éléments](https://skillshop.exceedlms.com/student/activity/8380-evaluation-sur-la-monetisation-des-elements): Assessment evaluation for YouTube monetization with 75% passing requirement.
